items.headline: Missouri's Ahmad Hardy returns nearly 6 months after being shot in leg
items.description: Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy returned to the field on Saturday night, nearly six months after being wounded in the leg during a shooting at an outdoor concert.

items.headline: Jamal Roberts speaks on how the run game boosts No. 23 Mizzou
items.description: Coming off a 138-yard performance in the win against Arkansas, Roberts explains how he was able to run effectively thanks to the Tigers' offensive line.

items.headline: Austin Simmons leads No. 23 Missouri to 34-10 win over Arkansas
items.description: — Austin Simmons threw for 179 yards and two touchdowns, and Jamal Roberts had 158 total yards and two touchdowns as No. 23 Missouri topped Arkansas 34-10 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Drinkwitz highlights RB Roberts, Mizzou's defense vs. Arkansas
items.description: Eliah Drinkwitz credits Jamal Roberts for his consistent production on the ground and praises the Tigers' defense for forcing four turnovers, including one returned for a touchdown.
